messages.author: 9bf5070a8dccf419
messages.subject: multiple data sets
parts:
Is it possible to analyze multiple data sets with R/qtl (such as
combining two F2 data sets or two backcross data sets)? If so, what is
the best way to do this?

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: multiple data sets
parts:
There's no automatic way to do this, and I certainly wouldn't
want to say that I know what the best way to do it is.

One approach is to get the maps lined up exactly, and combine
the two crosses into one, but with a covariate indicating which
cross an individual is from, and then doing the QTL analysis with
that covariate included in the model.

regards,
karl
